description: Find online stores on CouponBricks by name (e.g. "helium 10", "saunaspace"). Returns the store name, its slug for get_coupons, how many live offers it has, and its coupon page.

country.description: Shopper's country as a 2-letter code: US, IN, AE, SG, MY or JP. Any other value (or none) uses the CouponBricks global site.

query.description: Store name or part of it.

name: search_stores
title: Find a store
